mentions.name: Narro
mentions.description: Narro is a user-curated social media aggregator. Users enter the profiles they want to follow across Instagram, X, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, or TikTok, and Narro pulls all the posts into one place without ads or an algorithmic feed.
mentions.problem: Mainstream social media feeds are cluttered with ads and algorithmic recommendations.
mentions.source_excerpt:
User curated social media app called Narro

https://narro.info

The idea is that you enter in the profiles you want to follow across Instagram, X, Facebook, Youtube, Linkedin or TikTok, and Narro pulls the posts into one place without ads or the algorithm.
mentions.author: scientifik

mentions.name: Narro
mentions.description: This app lets users view social media content without ads or algorithms. Users add profiles from Instagram, X, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, or YouTube and Narro pulls in the posts from those profiles.
mentions.problem: Social media feeds are cluttered with ads and algorithmic content.
